meta.name: add-github
meta.description: Add GitHub channel integration via Chat SDK. PR and issue comment threads as conversations.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 将 GitHub 的 PR 和 Issue 评论同步为聊天会话
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在聊天中跟进 GitHub 上的代码审查和问题讨论
copy.tagline_en: Sync GitHub PR and issue comments into chat conversations
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to follow GitHub code reviews and issue discussions in chat

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 会通过 Chat SDK 接入 GitHub,能参与 PR 和 issue 的评论讨论。配置完成后,当有人 @ 机器人时会回复,之后该讨论串的后续评论也会继续回应。
howto.when: 在 GitHub 仓库配置好 webhook 后,当有人在 PR 或 issue 评论中 @ 机器人账号时触发;首次 @ 后,同一讨论串的后续评论也会自动回复。

say.text: 我的仓库是私有的,请用 public 策略接线 GitHub
say.note: 会按私有仓库策略创建频道并接线

say.text: 帮我运行构建和注册测试,验证 GitHub 适配器装好了

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude connects to GitHub via Chat SDK and can participate in PR and issue comment threads. Once configured, it replies when @-mentioned and follows the rest of that thread.
howto.when_en: Triggers when someone @-mentions the bot account in a PR or issue comment, after the repo webhook is configured. After the first mention, it also responds to subsequent comments in that thread.

say_en.text: Set up GitHub integration; I'll paste the token, webhook secret, and bot username.
say_en.note: Prompts for each value and writes them to .env

say_en.text: My repo is private; wire GitHub with a public unknown-sender policy.
say_en.note: Creates the channel using the private-repo policy

say_en.text: Run the build and registration test to verify the GitHub adapter.
say_en.note: Executes the build and github-registration vitest test
